entities.name: Amhara Democratic Party
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
The Amhara Democratic Party (ADP, later renamed the Amhara National Movement, now part of the Prosperity Party) was one of the ethnic-based regional parties in Ethiopia's ruling coalition (EPRDF, Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front) from 1991 to 2019, representing the Amhara region of Ethiopia — home to Ethiopia's most historically powerful ethnic group that dominated the Ethiopian Empire under the Solomonic dynasty emperors and the Haile Selassie monarchy.

Ethiopia's ethnic federalism — established by the EPRDF after it overthrew the Derg military dictatorship in 1991 — organized the country along ethnic-regional lines, with each major ethnic group having its own regional state and a corresponding ethnic party within the ruling coalition. The Amhara Democratic Party (originally the Amhara National Democratic Movement) represented the Amhara regional state, giving institutional form to Amhara political interests within a federal system designed partly to prevent any single ethnic group's domination.

The Amhara question in Ethiopian politics is extraordinarily complex: Amharas were historically the dominant group of the Solomonic empire (Amharic became Ethiopia's official language, the Orthodox church used Ge'ez, an Amhara cultural tradition) but were subject to the EPRDF's ethnic federalism framework that limited Amhara influence. The ADP's evolution, its incorporation into Abiy Ahmed's Prosperity Party (2019), and the subsequent Tigray War (2020-2022) — in which Amhara militia fought alongside the federal government against the TPLF — all reflect Ethiopia's extraordinarily complex ethnic political dynamics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Amhara Democratic Party — representing Ethiopia's historically dominant Amhara ethnic group in the EPRDF's ethnic federal system, merged into the Prosperity Party before the Tigray War — is historically significant as a central institution of Ethiopia's fraught ethnic federalism experiment.
